engine_note: engine:xml_list selects the legacy RimWorld Engine via ENGINE_FACTORY. Kept PLANNED in production; the 33 historical tests pin DECKYMOD_GAME_ID=rimworld. This descriptor is NOT migrated to ManifestParser (archive.inspect_mod / state_mutator stay byte-identical).

identity.name: RimWorld
identity.note: HISTORICAL REGRESSION (selection B, approved 2026-11-14): this descriptor is PLANNED in production (active_game=stardew). The 33 synthetic-tree tests pin DECKYMOD_GAME_ID=rimworld to keep exercising it. AppID 294100 native Linux, no Proton prefix. ⚠️ VERIFICATION V9: exact installdir casing from appmanifest_294100.acf.

notes: state_file is W1 (internal SSD, POSIX). Path contains literal spaces; treat as a single string, never word-split. ⚠️ V14: verify exact path incl. XDG_CONFIG_HOME, casing, and 1.4/1.5/1.6 differences.
mod_root is W2 (the game install, possibly on microSD/exFAT). Each mod installs as its own DIRECTORY Mods/<packageId>/.

staging and quarantine are SIBLINGS of Mods/ (under GAME_ROOT), NOT inside Mods/. RimWorld scans Mods/ child dirs for About/About.xml; a staging/quarantine dir inside Mods/ could be misread. ⚠️ V16: confirm whether RimWorld ignores dot-directories.

Quarantine MUST live on W2's filesystem: cross-filesystem os.replace of a whole mod directory raises EXDEV(18). This is the single approved exception to review-#4 (journal/quarantine/logs in DECKY_DATA). journal still records original path, quarantine path and txn id.
state_staging is a sibling of the Config dir so atomic_replace of ModsConfig.xml never crosses filesystems.

loaders_note: Empty by design (selection A). No BepInEx/SMAPI/xNVSE/UE4SS/MelonLoader install in MVP. E_LOADER_REQUIRED and E_PROTON_PREFIX_MISSING are retained in the error table only as wording for planned games.

id_extraction.note: packageId legitimately contains dots (e.g. brrainz.harmony). validate_with lowercases before regex.

supported_versions_extraction.note: Informational badge only. MVP does NOT reject on version mismatch.

mod_package.metadata_badges_note: <loadAfter>/<dependencies> from About.xml are shown as info badges ONLY. No dependency solver, no load-order solver (both capability=false).
mod_package.notes: Windows .exe/.msi installers are refused outright (§3.4 forward-looking constraint). We never execute archive contents. The archive is unpacked, not installed.

state_mutator.core_invariant: activeMods must contain ludeon.rimworld as the FIRST <li>. Missing or out of position -> E_CORE_MISSING, operation refused.
state_mutator.preserve_unknown_entries_note: DLC (ludeon.rimworld.*), Workshop items, and any <li> we did not create are left byte-for-byte untouched. We only add/remove the single <li> for the managed packageId.
notes:
install != enable. install = unpack dir into Mods//; enable = append
  • packageId
    • to .

surgical_line_edit: ElementTree is used ONLY to validate/parse the file read-only. The WRITE inserts or deletes exactly one
  • ...
    • line inside the block and leaves every other byte (comments, indentation, , knownExpansions) unchanged. ElementTree re-serialization would drop comments/formatting - forbidden. ⚠️ V15: confirm RimWorld accepts this write-back.
RimWorld may rewrite ModsConfig.xml on quit -> verify_on_open and E_STATE_EXTERNAL drift detection are mandatory (safety.verify_on_open=true).

conflict_policy.file_collision_note: If Mods/<packageId>/ already exists and is NOT tracked in our journal -> E_FILE_COLLISION (refuse, never silently overwrite).

known_limitations: insert_mode=append_to_end + load_order_solver=false + dependency_solver=false: ordering-sensitive mods (e.g. brrainz.harmony must load before dependants) appended at the END may not work. Reordering must be done in-game by the user (out of MVP). This is stated honestly in the UI.
No automatic conflict/dependency resolution, no network/Workshop, no loaders, no load-order editing, no Proton prefix access, no .exe installers.
